description: Compare N-terminal hydropathy of THI22 vs paralogs to test whether the predicted signal peptide is family-atypical
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg'); import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def seq(acc):
    d=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.json",timeout=60).json()
    return d['sequence']['value']

accs={'THI22':'Q06490','THI20':'Q08224','THI21':'Q08975'}
seqs={k:seq(v) for k,v in accs.items()}
for k,s in seqs.items():
    print(k, accs[k], 'len',len(s))
    print('  N-term(1-60):', s[:60])

# Kyte-Doolittle hydropathy
kd={'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,'H':-3.2,
'I':4.5,'L':3.8,'K':-3.9,'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2}
def hydro(s,w=9):
    v=[kd[a] for a in s]
    out=[]
    half=w//2
    for i in range(len(v)):
        lo=max(0,i-half); hi=min(len(v),i+half+1)
        out.append(np.mean(v[lo:hi]))
    return np.array(out)

plt.figure(figsize=(10,4))
for k in ['THI22','THI20','THI21']:
    h=hydro(seqs[k][:80])
    plt.plot(range(1,len(h)+1),h,label=f"{k} ({accs[k]})",lw=2 if k=='THI22' else 1)
plt.axhline(1.6,ls='--',c='grey',label='signal-peptide-like threshold (~1.6)')
plt.axvspan(1,19,color='red',alpha=0.1,label='THI22 predicted signal 1-19')
plt.xlabel('Residue position (N-terminal 80 aa)'); plt.ylabel('Kyte-Doolittle hydropathy (win=9)')
plt.title('N-terminal hydropathy: THI22 vs paralogs THI20/THI21'); plt.legend(fontsize=8); plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('nterm_hydropathy.png',dpi=120)
print("\nMax hydropathy in first 25 aa:")
for k in ['THI22','THI20','THI21']:
    print(f"  {k}: {hydro(seqs[k][:25]).max():.2f}")

# N-glyc sequons N-X-[ST] (X!=P) in first 40 aa of THI22
import re
s22=seqs['THI22']
sequons=[(m.start()+1,s22[m.start():m.start()+3]) for m in re.finditer(r'N[^P][ST]', s22[:40])]
print("\nTHI22 N-glyc sequons in first 40 aa:", sequons)
print("(N-glycosylation sequons are only modified on secretory/ER-lumen proteins - relevant but predictive only)")
